retained: execution_progress.phase6_specialist; approved P6-T1 plan/spec. No prior eligibility or external research repeated.

pending_renderer.qualification: API/output convention approved with original safe compatibility assertions and negatives preserved. Implementation active; no moving gherkin/test bytes bound here.

existing_surface.capture: capture_workspace(*, workspace_root, profile_path, metadata, read_bytes, catalog, repository=None)->CapturedWorkspace; SnapshotIO and PathPolicy own bounded non-following local reads. load_snapshot(*,io,profile_path,repository=None,catalog=None) composes immutable input bytes; reuse accepted exact definition when implementing.
existing_surface.configuration: select_configuration(*,candidates,locator,activation,catalog,profile_path=None,controlled=False); ActivationStore.configure(ConfigurationRequest)->ConfigurationResult with trusted authorize_root/revocation/store collaborators. InitializationIO provides bootstrap capture; plan_initialization/commit_initialization and plan_migration/commit_migration preserve no-overwrite and partial-result semantics.
existing_surface.validation: validate_snapshot(snapshot:DiscoverySnapshot|None,*,mode,invocation=None)->SnapshotValidation; report_projection(snapshot,*,kind,identifier,mode)->dict[str,object]. Root mode reports must use these public authoritative projections; agent-output retains distinct output_valid versus review PASS/FAIL.
existing_surface.mutation: plan_mutation(baseline,changes:tuple[MutationChange,...],*,grants:tuple[WriteGrant,...],invocation=None,transport=None)->MutationPlan; commit_mutation(plan,*,writer:MutationWriter,dry_run=False)->MutationResult. Grants authenticate exact kind/id/path; null expected hash means absence; replacement requires captured digest. Writer recaptures full state under guards and invalidates authority before attempted writes; preserve partial/uncertain paths on failure.
existing_surface.drafts: plan_contract(baseline,ContractDraft,*,grants,invocation=None), plan_scenario(baseline,ScenarioDraft,*,grants,invocation=None), plan_evidence_link(baseline,EvidenceLink,*,grants,invocation=None) return MutationPlan. Whole-document updates use MutationChange/plan_mutation; no text patch or direct overwrite.
existing_surface.inventory: capture_snapshot(snapshot)->InventoryCapture; pin_inventory_sources(workspace,repository)->CapturedWorkspace must be composed consistently in initial and writer.capture paths. run_inventory(capture,*,timestamp,author_or_agent,catalog,dry_run=False)->InventoryResult and plan_inventory(baseline,result,*,grants,invocation=None) reconstruct exact captured inputs. select_analyzers(profile)->tuple[InventoryAdapter,...] is fixed and consent-aware.
existing_surface.extensions: merge_extension_inventory(snapshot,*,timestamp,author_or_agent,manifest_paths=None)->InventoryResult. Data-only imported manifests; no executable/module configuration. Generate merged content internally then validated mutation; do not feed a merged result into core-only plan_inventory reconstruction or bypass claim validation.
existing_surface.reports: build_coverage_report/build_parity_report/build_completion_report produce DiscoveryReport from public report_projection. plan_completion_report(baseline,*,mode,grants,identifier="completion")->MutationPlan plans exact JSON/Markdown report paths. Coverage/parity/validation pair publication must compose same report_projection/DiscoveryReport/MutationChange/plan_mutation, not duplicate gate calculations or use legacy write_report.
existing_surface.acceptance: generate_acceptance(snapshot,*,kind,feature_ids:tuple[tuple[str,str],...]=(),client_ids:tuple[str,...]=(),mode_ids:tuple[str,...]=())->AcceptanceGeneration. Render exact generated result through approved render_acceptance contract. Structured specifications retain owner outside JSON; ready views only generation.ready. Plan all intended source and rendered outputs together with exact grants/CAS and one prospective validation; do not write rendered output before structured validation. Existing path_policy maps acceptance-specification and acceptance-view to the acceptance root; plan_mutation already permits opaque acceptance-view .md/.feature bytes while validating the structured prospective graph. Use that route for generated views; no new publication bypass is required.
existing_surface.source_reads: SourceReader(profile,*,catalog,workspace_root,metadata,read_bytes,selection,limits=DEFAULT_LIMITS).inspect(SourceReadRequest)->SourceReadResult. ReadSelection is caller-authenticated, not deserialized from request. Retain bounds, freshness and literal/regex policy.
existing_surface.resources: __version__, load_resource_manifest/read_resource and core catalog use installed importlib resources with hashes. ResourceManifest records runtime_version and resource entries; it does not itself provide a full Python-build digest or numeric policy-version provenance.

service_contract.entry: execute(request, *, io, repository_reader, clock, analyzer_registry) -> DiscoveryResult; freeze typed request/result and collaborator Protocols before independent handlers.
service_contract.io: Trusted ServiceIO owns explicit workspace binding, local input reads/capture, authenticated principal/context/grants/read selection, configured activation store, guarded writer, installed resources and bootstrap/migration adapters. Request JSON supplies data and opaque correlation refs only; it cannot supply collaborators, authority storage, grants or role claims.
service_contract.principal: Explicit trusted local-user principal selects root local path. A host principal must resolve and consume authenticated protected invocation/authorization refs and bind workspace/profile/request digest/expiry/one-use before returning InvocationContext/grants/ReadSelection. Missing/unavailable host provider fails closed with exit3; never fall back to local-user because attribution is absent. InvocationContext construction or mirrored JSON schema validation grants no authority.
service_contract.registry: Trusted injected registry must expose only fixed known identifiers, enforce configured selection/consent and reject unknown selectors before imports. Request values never choose Python functions/modules/executables. Preserve plan_inventory reconstruction against published bytes.
service_contract.clock: Injected callable supplies explicit capture timestamp/attribution where required; no clock contributes to deterministic report or acceptance identity/content digest. Freeze return type/RFC3339 conversion once.
service_contract.result: Immutable versioned result validates against exact service-result schema before serialization. Map stable findings with ordered_findings; artifacts carry normalized path/kind/planned|created|updated|skipped|conflict/hash and optional content. summary has closed message/counts/validation_result/receipt_ref/invocation_ref fields, not arbitrary report JSON. Keep full report bodies in artifacts.content; unavailable metrics must not be converted to true-zero counts.
service_contract.exit: 0 selected operation/gate passes;1 blocking graph/semantic findings;2 malformed invocation/configuration/path/version;3 dependency/I/O/authority/runtime failure. Preserve original MutationError findings and partial writes. Do not catch every ValueError as invocation error: classify at the parsing, authority, projection or commit boundary. Native output validity and review failure cannot be collapsed into unconditional ok.

fixed_operations.rule: Match canonical schema enum exactly; validate required/forbidden inputs, modes, write/dry-run/format combinations for each operation before I/O. P6-T2 maps aliases/dotnet/vsto shortcuts. Host-deferred operations return explicit unavailable authority until P8 integration, never a synthetic native receipt.

gateway_doctor.gateway: Fixed python -I -m drm_copilot_discovery.gateway; bounded one-request stdin JSON with duplicate-key/nonfinite/depth/size rejection via parse_document. No shell/string interpolation, executable/module dispatch, multiple requests, trailing junk or mixed log/result stdout. One bounded versioned JSON response, matching process exit; stderr diagnostics remain separate. Inject stream/adapter seams for memory-only tests; no subprocess in unit tests.
gateway_doctor.doctor: Read-only installed package/catalog/resource integrity plus configuration selection/profile findings. Initially explicit native-capability unavailable and receipt_ref=null; no configured boolean/JSON can claim attestation. Plain local runtime health and unavailable agent capability are distinct; requesting a native capability cannot yield success until P8-T8 protected probe provider exists.

concrete_decisions_before_release: Request feature_ids are unqualified strings while accepted generate_acceptance takes repository/feature pairs. Freeze unqualified resolution with ambiguous IDs rejected, optionally using the existing repository_id as a single-source selector, or authorize an exact canonical request-schema qualified-selector extension; never guess among same-named features. platform_ids is present in request schema but generator has no platform selector: reject unsupported use or approve explicit semantics, not silently ignore it.

Result operation/mode are closed valid enums even for exit2, so malformed JSON or unknown operation/mode cannot be truthfully echoed in a valid result. Freeze an explicit malformed-request envelope convention or narrowly authorized conditional schema change; do not mislabel failure as doctor/structural or fabricate a requested operation.

Result runtime requires build_sha256, integer policy_version and policy_sha256 even during missing/corrupt-runtime failures. Freeze actual installed build/policy provenance and an unavailable-runtime failure representation. Do not label a resource-only digest as full runtime build identity without a documented contract or fill unknown hashes with invented zeros.

run_inventory and plan_inventory hardwire select_analyzers(profile). Service injected registry and requested analyzer subset/shortcut must preserve reconstruction. Either define the port as accepted fixed-pipeline execution with strict configured selection, or approve one cohesive public selection seam threaded through execution/reconstruction; a fake/filtered result cannot bypass current planner checks.
ownership_proposal: Contract owner: new service_contracts.py (proposed prerequisite) plus test_service_failures.py owns immutable request/result, typed trusted ports, envelope/error mapping and strict operation input contracts. This avoids extending accepted general models.py and prevents shared-file conflicts.

Service owner: service.py and operations.py plus test_service.py owns execute/capture/authorization and fixed map composition. Four planned production files alone risk one operations module exceeding500 lines across30 canonical operations; allocate cohesive service_reports.py and service_mutations.py only after concrete handler sizing, with exact ownership before edits. Do not split one operation between concurrent writers.

Gateway/doctor owner: gateway.py, doctor.py and test_gateway.py/test_doctor.py consumes frozen contracts/ports and installed metadata provider. No CLI registrations or legacy adapter changes; P6-T2/T3 retain those boundaries.
smallest_tests: Parameterize the closed operation map with real supported validators and in-memory captured fixtures; each operation gets one successful or accurate blocked composition, not repeated predecessor internal matrices.
Request field/mode/write/dry-run/format boundary table; aliases normalized only by future CLI; unknown operation/extra execution field rejected before collaborator calls.

Explicit local-user versus authenticated host; forged/null/stale/replayed/mismatched refs, agent-output missing InvocationContext, root-only operation denial, unavailable native provider, no role fallback.

Whole operation capture+pin+projection+plan+fresh recapture+commit using in-memory seams; no-write dry-run, exact CAS, unchanged idempotency, concurrent source changes, partial/uncertain writes and authority-revocation failure. Reuse accepted low-level proofs.

Gateway one versioned result, duplicate/nonfinite/trailing/truncated/oversized inputs, inconsistent result rejected, clean stdout/process status, read/write dependency failures; no unit process/tempfiles/network.
Doctor installed resources/version/profile success or exact missing/corrupt diagnostics; native unavailable cannot self-attest; no writes/Git/process/network or hidden config mutation.
Authoritative report body/selected mode, unavailable versus zero, generated-doc digest stability; acceptance exact generated result and structured/rendered publication. Bind P5-T5 final hashes later.

dependent_callers.legacy: Sets A-F adapter tests remain P6-T3 unless P6-T1 actually changes an existing public caller. No current Python service/gateway implementation or caller was found; new API tests are planned paths.
dependent_callers.registration: Retain prior exact P6-T2 test_init_cli.test_console_script_registered_in_pyproject disposition. Keep runtime [tool.poetry.scripts] before dependencies per accepted inventory assertion.
dependent_callers.schema_prerequisite: Any approved wire-schema change must update canonical schema, bundled/runtime copies and affected catalog/control tests through existing resource packaging rules; do not silently alter only a local schema.

timing: Retain P8 timeout/cancellation follow-on: evidence/qa-gates/p5t3-final-native-094649.2026-10-20T09-51.json records guarded creation and replacement each exceeding71seconds. This is measured native composition, not a proven host timeout limit. Keep cancellation/partial-result boundaries observable; no unrelated optimization or timeout workaround in P6 preparation.
